name: refract
description: Trajectory-aware AI prompt interceptor and coach. Refracts rough prompts and follow-ups through your full conversation history and workspace context, rescues debugging loops, and provides /refract, /refract-check, and /refract-mode.
suggestedPrompts: /refract-check Audit my prompt and conversation health with an interactive scorecard
/refract make this handler async and fix the error
/refract-mode Switch Refract between Auto-Intercept Mode and Coach Mode
